version.philosophy: A change is verified for one exact state: a repository, a commit and working-tree state, an environment, and the versions of the procedures that ran. Evidence says what ran and what did not, and it is recorded so that a later agent can rely on it, or see where it stops.
version.method: Establish the execution context, resolve the bound procedure in it, run the build and then the checks through their references, record each child execution before the parent that links them, and confirm the verification Polaroid derives.

inputs.working_tree: `clean`, or `modified:` with the SHA-256 of the uncommitted changes. Set by the agent at run time, never by a binding.

preconditions: A local checkout of the repository, with the change to verify committed or its working-tree state recorded.
A Polaroid binding of this procedure in the repository, whose inputs supply the commands and paths.
contract.expected_outcome: Both child executions succeeded and are linked, and the parent execution is verified.
verification: get_verification on the parent execution reports verified, with a combination naming the repository, commit, environment, inputs and both child versions.
boundaries: Verification holds only for the recorded repository, commit, environment, inputs and child versions. It says nothing about another repository or environment.
Does not merge, push or close work items.

steps.action: From the module root, record `git rev-parse HEAD` (the full hash), the repository identifier from `git remote get-url origin` (host and path, lowercase, without scheme, user, port or `.git`), and an environment name in canonical-key form, for example `darwin-arm64.local`, with attributes such as the OS, architecture and tool versions.

Run `git status --porcelain`. If it prints nothing, working_tree is `clean`. Otherwise commit the changes first, or set working_tree to `modified:` followed by the SHA-256 of `git diff HEAD` and the untracked files. Never record a modified tree as `clean`.

Resolve the binding in your environment. For each reference, read the selected version of its procedure in full (philosophy, method, contract and instructions) before running it, and note how it was selected.
The effective inputs are the binding revision's inputs plus working_tree. Pass them to each reference through its input mapping.

Follow the `build` reference, then the `checks` reference. Record each child execution as soon as it finishes, with the exact version followed, this repository and commit, its effective inputs, its outcome and its evidence.
Record this procedure's execution with the effective inputs and `children` linking both child executions. Its outcome is `succeeded` only if both children succeeded.
Read the parent's verification and report it with the repository, commit, environment and child versions.

If a step fails, decide what failed before changing anything: wrong or outdated instructions, an environment blocker, or a defect in the product being verified. Only wrong instructions justify a new procedure version: append it with base_version set to the version you followed, run it, and record the new execution. Repair an environment blocker and record it; file a product defect as a work item. Never edit or delete earlier records.

version.revision_reason: Initial version, written for Polaroid's development (#28): verify a change through reusable build and check procedures, recording evidence for the exact state verified.
